items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: You remember Teddy Bunn? Leo Watson?

ctx.x: And how about small clubs. Were there small clubs around town?

We had little clubs that didn't mean a thing, like Billy Berg's. That was the best one of all. And all the rest of them, they couldn't make it. But Billy Berg, that was the most popular one. Like they had Teddy Bunn and that bunch. You remember Teddy Bunn? Leo Watson?
